tags.label: Greeting
tags.definition: The message opens with a greeting or sign-off phrase ('Guten Morgen', 'gm', 'hallo zusammen', '73', 'cześć'), whatever else it says.

tags.label: Weather
tags.definition: Contains a weather or environment report: temperature, humidity, pressure, wind, rain, pollen, water level, nowcast or telemetry values.

tags.label: QSL
tags.definition: Mentions a QSL card or contact confirmation: a request for a QSL, sending or confirming one, QSL bot/event-station exchanges ('pse QSL', 'QSL via bureau', 'QSL received, tnx').

tags.label: Test
tags.definition: A short message that tests reach or equipment: 'test', 'Test 1 2 3', 'Testnachricht', 'reichweitentest', radio check.

tags.label: Question
tags.definition: Any interrogative message: a question to the network, including setup and help questions, requests for a contact or frequency, radio checks and small talk ('hat jemand ...?', 'hoert mich jemand?', 'wie geht's?').

tags.label: QSO
tags.definition: Human conversation: replies, statements, reports, chit-chat, thanks. Derived, not matched: a message with none of the automated tags (auto_beacon, weather, bulletin, pota-sota, alert) is qso, alongside any greeting, question, test or qsl. Weather blocks qso unless there is conversation evidence (leading @CALL addressee, 1:1 DM, or a question); a weather report with only a greeting is not qso.

tags.label: Bulletin
tags.definition: News or bulletin for many readers: contest calendars, club-evening and net reminders, event announcements, newsletters -- informational rather than urgent.

tags.label: POTA/SOTA
tags.definition: Automated activator/award spot feed: '[POTA] SP9NLI @ Park | 18.089 MHz CW', '[SOTA] SP0KE @ Summit | 14.330 MHz SSB', '[DYPLOM] ... | 7.074 MHz FT8'. A human sentence that merely mentions POTA, SOTA or an award is not a spot.

tags.label: Alert
tags.definition: Emergency, warning or urgent safety-relevant information: Notfall, SOS, earthquake, storm/flood warning, outage alert. A routine reminder with a warning emoji is a bulletin, not an alert.

tags.label: URL
tags.definition: The message contains a web link (http, https or www): a camera page, a homepage, a forum, a download. Added next to the other tags. A link says nothing about whether a person wrote the text.

tags.label: Auto beacon
tags.definition: Automated: it carries the same message over and over again. Machine output such as node status banners, bot and command replies, software or firmware announcements, clock lines and file-transfer frames.

topics.label: Greeting
topics.definition: The message contains a greeting or sign-off WORD: a hello or good-day phrase ('Guten Morgen', 'gm', 'hallo', 'servus', 'ciao', 'buongiorno', 'cześć', 'hi'), a goodbye ('tschüss', 'bis bald', 'gute Nacht'), or a radio sign-off ('73', 'vy 73', '73 de ...'). Without such a word it is not a greeting, however friendly.

topics.label: Question
topics.definition: The message asks something: a question mark at the end of a sentence, or an interrogative sentence without the mark ('hört mich jemand', 'wer ist QRV').

topics.label: Test
topics.definition: The message tests reach, equipment or software, or says that someone is testing: it contains a test word ('test', 'testen', 'teste', 'prova', 'probe', 'essai', 'Testnachricht', 'radio check') or is a counting or alphabet pattern typed to check reach ('1 2 3', 'abc', '123456789').

topics.label: QSL
topics.definition: The message is about a QSL card or contact confirmation: the word QSL (or 'QSL-Karte', 'confirmation card') with a request, a sending, a confirmation, or a link to a QSL card.

topics.label: Weather
topics.definition: The message reports or remarks on the weather or environment: measured values (temperature, humidity, pressure, wind, rain, pollen, water level) or a plain remark ('es regnet', 'bei mir Nebel').

topics.label: Bulletin
topics.definition: An announcement to many readers about something scheduled or published: an event with a date or time, a net or club evening, a contest or contest calendar, a meeting, a newsletter, or a firmware or software release. It is written as an announcement, not as a turn in a conversation.

topics.label: POTA/SOTA
topics.definition: An activator or award spot line: '[POTA] CALL @ Park | 14.074 MHz FT8', '[SOTA] ...', '[DYPLOM] ...'.

topics.label: Alert
topics.definition: A warning or an all-clear about danger to people or infrastructure: emergency, SOS, earthquake, storm or flood warning, outage, and the matching all-clear ('Entwarnung', 'VERDE').

topics.label: Link
topics.definition: The message contains a web link (http, https or www). Applies next to every other topic.
